title.narrative: Programa de Fomento a la Productividad Agropecuaria Sostenible
Sustainable Agricultural Productivity Development Program

description.narrative: El objetivo general es incrementar la productividad agropecuaria sostenible, fortalecer su vinculacin con las cadenas de valor y promover el aumento de los ingresos de las familias rurales. El objetivo especfico es promover la investigacin, difusin y transferencia tecnolgica, con nfasis en cambio climtico y produccin agroecolgica y el aseguramiento de la oferta de alimentos sanos e inocuos.

The general objective is to increase the productivity of sustainable agriculture, strengthen linkages with value chains, and boost rural family income. The specific objective is to promote technology research, dissemination, and transfer, with an emphasis on climate change, agroecological production, and a secure supply of healthy and safe foods.
